organisations: the tenant root table itself — its own id is the organisation id every other table scopes by
permissions: global lookup of permission keys shared by every org, not client data (role_permissions/user_permissions that grant them do carry org_id)
service_popularity: anonymous, cross-visitor aggregate counter keyed by service slug; no client or tenant data
service_popularity_hits: anonymous per-IP rate-limit dedupe rows for the popularity counter; no client or tenant data
front_door_rate: anonymous per-IP rate-limit rows (hashed IP only) for the front-door proposal limiter; no client or tenant data
portal_approvers: keyed by auth_user_id only, RLS on with zero grants to any API role; who may approve is staff-internal config, not client data
